realism.couplings_note: Stäubli rates the CombiTac's power, data and fluid inserts and the align frame at 100,000 mating cycles (CombiTac overview, CT-Overview-11014010). A tray's plate mates twice per presentation, its Shuttle's bay dock once per presentation of any of its trays.
realism.ups_note: each transfer is about 6 s on the battery; estimate from a 230 V 5PX 1500's 44 min at 300 W (a retailer's figure, notes/services.md). VRLA is rated 200 cycles at 100 % depth of discharge, 1,200 at 30 % (Yuasa NP12-12): these transfers add only a few equivalent full cycles a year, so float life and heat set the battery's life (3-5 years at 25 °C, Eaton), not the transfers.
realism.units_note: assumed: the UR10e's 350 W typical (UR) and the MiR250's drive and computers; MiR250 battery, Li-NMC 47.7 V 34.2 Ah, at least 3,000 cycles (a reseller's spec sheet, robotsoflondon); Robotiq: fingertips at 1 million cycles, overhaul at 2 million (2F-85 manual)

storage.note: Kept whole, a year of stream video needs about this much disk, mirrored, every year, against a few TB of instrument data. The retention policy (assumed) keeps a rolling buffer, a clip around every failure, interrupted step, dripped run and cracked build, and a time-lapse.
